name: sonarqube
description: SonarQube MCP server for explaining quality gates, searching issues and reading measures

tools.name: sonarqube_quality_gate
tools.description: Explain why a quality gate is red: status, new-code period, and conditions with the failing ones first (ratings as A-E)

tools.name: sonarqube_issues
tools.description: Search a project's unresolved issues with file, line, rule, severity, type, message, author and creation date

tools.name: sonarqube_measures
tools.description: Read measures for a project, e.g. coverage, bugs, new_coverage, reliability_rating (ratings shown as A-E)

tools.name: sonarqube_issue_source
tools.description: Show the source lines around a line of a component, as returned by sonarqube_issues (component and line)

tools.name: sonarqube_branches
tools.description: List a project's branches with their quality gate status and last analysis date

tools.name: sonarqube_projects
tools.description: List or search projects the token can see
